articles.title: Drone-Delivered Gel Speeds Healing on Ukraine's Front Lines
articles.summary: A Calgary-made gel that speeds healing is being flown by drone to Ukraine's front lines, where it has treated 6,000 wounded soldiers and civilians since June.

articles.title: Personal Details of 40,000 Homeland Security Workers Appear Online
articles.summary: A leak website says it published personal details of more than 40,000 Homeland Security employees; DHS says it is working on a potential breach, and the full trove has not been independently verified.

articles.title: 300,000 People in the Path of Himalayan Disasters as Building Booms
articles.summary: A new study finds at least 300,000 people now live in the path of potential Himalayan disasters as tourism, housing, and hydropower expand along rivers and glacial lakes.
